usage: Local mock media artwork and stills for native UI visual QA; no UI labels, menus, controls or full-screen mockups are bundled.
extraction: Crop from committed Figma PNG renders at 2x using redesign/tools/figma/figma_ref.py; fractional origins are resampled bilinearly exactly as the crop tool.
limitations: The original Figma image-fill binaries are unavailable; rendered crops preserve image-local overlays and corner clipping.
Grid Wand thumbnails include the Figma 20% black image-fill overlay. Home-specific named variants preserve the brighter Home image fills. Do not apply a second imageOverlay when comparing snapshots.
player-cat is a 20pt inset media-only crop of Hide UI, excluding all window chrome; it is not the original uncropped image fill.
dont-blink is the designed solid-black Home media thumbnail; it excludes its progress strip.

Home E05–E07 retain full image geometry; the overlapping 4pt progress strip is excluded by replacing only its orange pixels with the known flat-black underlying media area. These are cropped media fixtures, never UI screenshots.

Compact/list32×32pt image-only fixtures preserve their square FILL framing. E01–E04 orange28×3pt progress-child rectangles are replaced with the preceding media row, so the obscured raw-media strip is inferred and the native UI draws progress separately. Radius2 corner context is uncomposited using the flattened alpha and known surrounding panel RGBA;8-bit coverage rounding limits exact recovery of those28 corner pixels. Native UI clips once.
ListE05 uses its identical clean compact photo before source-selected black70% and warm20% image paints; native UI applies those selected layers and draws the play glyph. No glyph pixels are bundled.

Grid WandE01–E04 preserve the full632×356px canvas. The excluded8pixel bottom progress strip is inferred from the preceding clean media row without rescaling the original632×348media pixels; native UI draws4pt progress separately.
